cross-realm: $262.createRealm: the shell makes one realm, as each thread of Lynx has.
resizable-arraybuffer: PrimJS has no resizable ArrayBuffer, which no fill can add.
regexp-v-flag: PrimJS's RegExp has no v flag, which no fill can add: the build refuses it.
Error.isError: ES2026, past the ES2025 the package fills.
error-stack-accessor: A proposal past ES2025, which the package doesn't fill.
immutable-arraybuffer: A proposal past ES2025 (ArrayBuffer's transferToImmutable), which the package doesn't fill.
iterator-sequencing: ES2026's Iterator.concat, past the ES2025 the package fills.
joint-iteration: A proposal past ES2025 (Iterator.zip and zipKeyed), which the package doesn't fill.
iterator-chunking: A proposal past ES2025 (Iterator.prototype.chunks and windows), which the package doesn't fill.
iterator-includes: A proposal past ES2025 (Iterator.prototype.includes), which the package doesn't fill.
Iterator.prototype.join: A proposal past ES2025 (Iterator.prototype.join), which the package doesn't fill.
explicit-resource-management: ES2026's using and Symbol.dispose, past the ES2025 the package fills.
